      How it works

      From bricks to race in three steps

      STEP 1

      Build

      Put your bricks on the chassis. A sports car, a truck, a spaceship: anything that fits on the studs.

      STEP 2

      Pair

      Turn on the controller and the car. They connect on their own. Name your car from your phone.

      STEP 3

      Race

      Drive against your friends. Pick a game mode, use your abilities, beat the best lap.

      FAQ

      Questions

      Does it fit my bricks?

      Yes. The chassis uses the standard stud size, so common building bricks fit on top. Bricks are not included.

      What is in the starter set?

      One chassis, one controller and a USB-C cable, in the BrickSpeed box.

      How do updates work?

      New seasons, like the Halloween and Christmas updates, come over Wi-Fi through the controller and install when nobody is racing.

      When is the race station coming?

      It is still in development. Leave your email above and we will tell you when it is ready.

      Is it for small children?

      No, it contains small parts. Not for children under 3.
